verdict.rationale: Founder Law is an attorney-led legal services firm, and a firm like this could plausibly offer AI-generated insights in a client portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such feature. Its intake is a short case-assessment form followed by attorney consultations and roadmaps, and its stated position favors accountable attorneys over automated legal tools. Neither of those is AI-generated insight from user data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
